cluster_name.description: The name of the Ceph cluster (used for config and keyring files).

instance_name.description: Unique identifier for this RGW instance (e.g., 'rgw1', 'rgw-proxy').

keyring_path.description: File path to the client keyring used for authentication to the Ceph cluster.

frontend_config.description: Frontend configuration string specifying host, port, and server backend (e.g., 'civetweb', 'fastcgi', 'nginx+uwsgi').

enabled_apis.description: List of REST APIs to enable: 's3', 'swift', 'swift_auth', 'admin', 'null'.

dns_name.description: DNS name used for virtual-hosted-style bucket access (e.g., 'bucket.rgw.example.com').

log_file_path.description: Path to the RGW daemon log file.

metadata_pool.description: Name of the pool used to store metadata (user info, buckets, etc.).

data_pool.description: Name of the primary data pool for objects (if using non-default layout).

s3_auth_use_rados.description: When true, use internal Rados (RADOS users) for S3/Swift authentication instead of external stores.

max_read_mb.description: Maximum size (in MB) of a single GET request body.

max_read_time_ms.description: Maximum time (in ms) allowed for a single GET request.

max_chunk_size.description: Maximum chunk size (in bytes) for multipart uploads.

op_thread_pool_size.description: Number of threads in the operation thread pool.

max_open_buckets.description: Maximum number of concurrently open bucket indexes.

bucket_index_max_shards.description: Number of shards for bucket index objects (increases scalability).

zone_enabled.description: Set to true to enable multi-site zone configuration.

zone_name.description: Name of the RGW zone in a multi-site configuration.

ssl_enabled.description: Enable TLS termination at the RGW instance level.

ssl_cert_path.description: Path to the SSL/TLS certificate for RGW.

ssl_key_path.description: Path to the SSL/TLS private key for RGW.
